title: Less than unanimous verdict authorized.
bodyText: In all civil cases tried before a jury it shall be sufficient for the return of a verdict if at least five-sixths of the jurors agree on the verdict.
crossReferences: Trial by jury, see Const. art. I, §13.

bodyHtml:
§635-20  Less than unanimous verdict authorized.  In all civil cases tried before a jury it shall be sufficient for the return of a verdict if at least five-sixths of the jurors agree on the verdict. [L 1965, c 171, §1; Supp, §231-28; HRS §635-20]
